calls.reason: The claim is mostly rhetorical. Broadcom's call shows heavy exposure to Anthropic and OpenAI, but its record free cash flow cuts against 'ruinous debt', and nothing shows either lab cannot slow down.
Company announcements before publication show Meta alone committed about $21B to CoreWeave and $12B of firm capacity to Nebius, well above $22B, though these are multi-year commitments.

Reporting confirms a force majeure notice on one project, said to be aimed at deferring payments, but Oracle denies any delay. No portfolio-wide schedule data or sign of refusing to repay debt was found.
NVIDIA's hyperscale revenue was about 51% of the quarter's total, which fits the premise. But this is a conditional forecast, and the evidence shows no end to the AI boom yet.
Leaked financials reported by Ars Technica put OpenAI's 2025 operating loss at $20.92B, and Anthropic's prospectus shows $8.06B, matching both figures on the same basis. Net losses were larger.

This is a conditional forecast. Nothing shows the condition has happened: no evidence of completed facilities followed by OpenAI nonpayment, and the two companies announced a new partnership on October 27.
